meanings.en: to applaud, to clap in approval
meanings.note: Imperfective verb. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to applaud, to clap', paired with 'поаплодировать'.

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.
